search.queryText:
_sourceCategory = Labs/OS/Linux/*  ("installed" or "erased" or "remove" or "<install>" or "<uninstall>") NOT "MTA" 
| parse regex "\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+status\s+(?<action>installed)\s+(?<pkg_name>\S*)\s+" nodrop 
| parse regex "\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<action>remove)\s+(?<pkg_name>[^ ]*)\s" nodrop 
| parse regex "\S*\s+\d+\s+\d+:\d+:\d+\s+(?<action>\w*):\s(?<pkg_name>[^ ]*)\s" nodrop 
| parse regex "<(?<action>[a-zA-Z]*)>\s+[^\(\)]*\(\d+\)(?<pkg_name>[^\(]*)\(" nodrop 
| if (action in ("Installed","install"), "installed",action) as action 
| if (action in ("uninstall","erased","remove"), "uninstalled",action) as action 
| _sourceHost as sourceHost | where action!=""
